bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for Legacy Coordination Network Education Fund.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; LEGACY COORDINATION NETWORK EDUCATION FUND. +]

[+$50,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Board of Directors of the Minnesota Humanities Center for grants to Legacy Coordination Network Education Fund for programming related to Minnesota African Diaspora Black History month and for educational outreach activities to teach youth and the general public about the historical and cultural contributions of African-heritage communities in Minnesota. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for Legacy Coordination Network Education Fund.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; LEGACY COORDINATION NETWORK EDUCATION FUND.

$50,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Board of Directors of the Minnesota Humanities Center for grants to Legacy Coordination Network Education Fund for programming related to Minnesota African Diaspora Black History month and for educational outreach activities to teach youth and the general public about the historical and cultural contributions of African-heritage communities in Minnesota.
additions: APPROPRIATION; LEGACY COORDINATION NETWORK EDUCATION FUND.
